financial-management.title: Financial Management System
financial-management.challenge: The client relied on a legacy, on-premise system that was slow, prone to errors, and lacked real-time reporting capabilities. They needed a secure, modern, and cloud-native solution to streamline their financial operations and scale with their growing user base.
financial-management.solution: We designed and developed a comprehensive financial dashboard featuring real-time data visualization, automated reporting, and secure role-based access controls. The architecture leveraged Next.js for the frontend and a scalable microservices backend.
financial-management.results: The new system reduced data processing time by 40%, eliminated manual reporting errors, and provided executives with immediate insights into financial health.

ecommerce-dashboard.title: E-Commerce Dashboard
ecommerce-dashboard.challenge: Managing inventory, tracking orders, and analyzing sales across multiple storefronts was a manual, disjointed process. The client required a centralized hub to monitor their entire e-commerce ecosystem in real time.
ecommerce-dashboard.solution: We built a customized analytics and management dashboard that integrated seamlessly with their existing Shopify and WooCommerce stores. It featured advanced filtering, sales forecasting algorithms, and intuitive charts.
ecommerce-dashboard.results: The centralized dashboard improved inventory turnover by 25% and saved the operations team over 15 hours a week in manual tracking.

Faq.title: Frequently Asked <italic>Questions</italic>
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our engineering standards, legal guarantees, and collaboration workflows.
Faq.q1: Who owns the intellectual property (IP) and source code?
Faq.a1: You own 100% of all intellectual property, source code, design assets, and database schemas from day one. Upon project completion and milestone releases, all repositories and assets are fully transferred to your accounts with zero vendor lock-in.
Faq.q2: How do you manage communication and time zones from Erbil?
Faq.a2: Our Erbil headquarters operates in the GMT+3 time zone, providing natural business-hour alignment with Europe, the Middle East (GCC), and substantial working-hours overlap with the Americas. We integrate directly into your company's communication channels (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, GitHub) with daily async updates and bi-weekly sprint demos.
Faq.q3: What are your typical project delivery timelines?
Faq.a3: Focused platforms and MVPs typically reach production within 6 to 10 weeks. Comprehensive enterprise software suites and cloud transformations generally span 3 to 6 months, organized into transparent two-week agile sprints with demonstrable working software at each stage.
Faq.q4: Can you collaborate with our existing internal tech team or legacy codebase?
Faq.a4: Absolutely. We frequently operate as an embedded engineering pod working alongside existing in-house developers, or take on phased refactoring of legacy systems with zero operational disruption to existing users and databases.
Faq.q5: What security standards and data confidentiality protections do you enforce?
Faq.a5: We enforce strict mutual enterprise NDAs before any technical exploration begins. All code adheres to OWASP security guidelines, role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end data encryption, and automated vulnerability scanning in our CI/CD pipelines.
Faq.q6: What happens after product launch? Do you provide ongoing maintenance and SLAs?
Faq.a6: Yes, we provide structured Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with defined response windows, 24/7 infrastructure telemetry monitoring, automated backups, continuous dependency updates, and dedicated engineering support packages.
